samples.question: The reference bar in the box at the top of the image shows an orientation. The image is divided into a left and a right half, and each half holds several identical thin bars, each drawn at one of several orientations. A bar matches the reference when it leans in the same direction as (is parallel to) the reference bar. Which half, left or right, contains MORE bars matching the reference orientation? Answer left or right.
